g.text: The platform is refused; nothing on this host has changed:
platform-active: name: platform 'oldplat' is active; a release of
The active platform oldplat is replaced by this release: its services
stop, the new platform's services start, and its releases, content,
state, restricted area and database stay on disk until you purge them
with pinka platform purge oldplat. Take a backup first.
